skill_vfx_assets.rotation: Single SQUARE sprite. Rotate about the texture center at runtime by the per-frame fan spin (Python _draw_fan_shape parity, spin += 0.3/frame). The 1:1 canvas + centered fan avoids the flat-quad continuous-rotation tumble trap (feedback_godot_immediate_rotation_tumble).
skill_vfx_assets.halo: 0 semi-transparent pixels after remove_bg.py (hard-edge nukki, no AI pastel-halo residue).

skill_vfx_assets.notes: Runtime draw small (~hit_radius 24 band). Centered on the square with ~6% margin so rotation corners do not clip. Re-import required.

skill_vfx_assets.notes: The boss skill HUD _draw_skillcard_gauge draws its OWN cooldown fill (fill_ratio horizontal clip), so this card carries NO baked gauge/progress bar (a v1 with a baked orange bar was rejected). Verify the gauge-fill interaction during Phase 3 HUD wiring. Re-import required.

skill_vfx_assets.qa: edge_alpha_max=0 on all 16 cells; content bbox center span 3.5px x / 2.0px y (stable center); content ~107-116px per 256 cell; light-bg + teal-bg composite previews clean (dark accents read as outline shading in this game's thick-outline style).
skill_vfx_assets.runtime: boss_fan_wind_sheet texture key. Renderer stage1_gaksital_fan_throw_renderer._draw_fan_wind_sheet draws frame = floor(fposmod(spin_phase, TAU)/TAU*16), draw diameter 128 * growth_scale, alpha fade over last 30f (timer_ratio < 0.125). Procedural vortex kept as null-texture fallback; capture ring + orbit ball accents stay procedural on top in both modes. Re-import required.
